audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows; content win[] and packet levelChart both give Sylas stages 1-6 and Anivia at 2+ items.
audit.why: Anivia is immobile and mana-starved early with a single slow projectile stun; two-item Anivia with Rylai's, egg and Glacial Storm out-zones an extended-fight bruiser.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content/packet, whys rewritten to match verdicts.

audit.why: Spikes coherent: Sylas 3-5 immobile-target punish, Sylas 6 (Abduct kills through Glacial Storm), Sylas first item, Anivia at two items — matches content.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit; Crystallize-vs-dash interaction understated.
audit.why: Kit: Q 11/10/9/8/7s, W (Crystallize) 17s flat and creates terrain — terrain blocks dashes, so a well-placed Wall can deny Abscond/Abduct paths; Glacial Storm recast is effectively always available (4/3/2s).
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; Wall-blocks-dash noted there.

audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; both bullets rewritten to their titles.

edits.before: - Anivia Flash Frost (Stun): matchup-defining — The slow-moving stun starts every Anivia kill — sidestep it and her E never doubles. It governs your forward steps. - E Abscond (shield-dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
